newsitem.title: UK: Ward Holdings up after family offer stocks.
newsitem.headline: Ward Holdings up after family offer stocks.

text.p: Shares in Ward Holdings Plc jumped on Monday following an announcement by the house building company that the Ward family, which holds over 51 percent of the shares, was looking to sell its stake.
Ward Holdings were up 11 pence, or 21 percent, at 60-1/2p by 0945 GMT, making it the day's top gainer.
"The company is for sale. That's what it is," a trader said.
The Ward family has controlled the company since it was floated in 1972.
Analysts said they were surprised about the statement, published by Ward today.
"It is rather unusual to issue such a statement," said one analyst who declined to be identified. "It seems to me that the company is already at an advanced stage of talks with a bidder."
It was very difficult to value Ward at moment, the analyst said, as the company's gave out little information.
Ward made a pre-tax loss of 2.6 million stg in the year to October 31, 1996 .
